text:
maya: customer hit a crash in sampleapp streaming path behind a corporate proxy (Win+Chrome). stack points at TextDecoder.decode failing on a chunk boundary.
eli: can you paste the server chunk trace?
maya: trimmed capture: 
```
OUT: data: {"id":42,"text":"Hey "}

OUT: data: {"id":42,"text":"\xF0\x9F\x98"}

OUT: data: {"id":42,"text":"\x8A"}

```
maya: proxy split the multi-byte emoji across reads and also injected an extra blank event between fragments. our browser fetch-based reader decodes per-chunk and then splits on "\n\n" -> JSON.parse each event. that's brittle.
sam: node SDK buffered bytes so it didn't crash. parity gap again.
ravi: two issues to handle: (1) streaming-safe decoding so decode doesn't throw on incomplete utf8, (2) tolerate proxy-inserted blank events and avoid re-emitting partial payloads.
eli: fix plan: use TextDecoder.decode(bytes, {stream:true}) and keep a leftover Uint8Array for incomplete sequences; ignore empty events (blank lines); implement a small "balanced-brace" heuristic to accept JSON that spans boundaries; and reset parser state on server comment markers (e.g., ":auth-refresh" or ":resume <token>") to avoid merging leftovers across reconnects.
sam: i'll author a tiny shared parser util for browser+node: createSseParser({onEvent,onComment}) with feed(chunk) and reset() methods. Implementation will: streaming-decode, accumulate text, split on double-newline but also try brace-balance, drop empty events, and treat colon-leading comment lines as reset markers when they indicate reauth/resume.
maya: also add diagnostic logging when a reconnect/auth-refresh occurs so we can triage merging issues from customer logs.
eli: add an integration test: proxy-mock that injects random CRLFs, splits utf8 codepoints mid-sequence, and inserts comment lines. run across Win/Chrome and node matrix. mark flaky tolerance thresholds.
ci-bot: queued: sampleapp-integration/proxy-sse-resilience (4 jobs).
devx-bot: created RDW-2122: "sse: robust parser for proxy-split utf8 and auth-reconnect races" and assigned to sam + eli.
maya: customer given temporary workaround (disable proxy compression). will update them once fix lands and add a short troubleshooting blurb in sampleapp README about proxies and streaming pitfalls.
sam: will open PR today with parser util, tests, and small docs blurb. aiming for minimal risk changes. :thumbsup:
